title: Around Town with Bolt! Car Wash, Garage and Traffic Light
intro: Hi, friends! I'm Bolt the little tow truck, and welcome to Tiny Truck Town!
Today we're taking a trip around town to visit five busy places and helpers.
Can you count them with me? One, two, three, four, five!
We'll stop at the corner, the gas station, the car wash, the garage and more!

lines: Here's our first stop. Here's a clue: it has three lights: red, yellow and green! Can you guess?
A traffic light helps cars take turns at the corner.
Red means stop. The cars stop and wait.
Yellow means slow down. Red is coming soon.
Can you guess what green means?
Green means go! Off the cars go!
Let's say it together: TRAFFIC LIGHT!
One more time, nice and loud: TRAFFIC LIGHT!
When we walk across the street, we always hold a grown-up's hand.
Who's next? Here's a clue: cars stop here to get fuel! Can you guess?
Cars and trucks need fuel to go, just like we need food.
A hose from the pump fills up the car's tank.
Grown-ups use the pump, and kids stay buckled in the car.
Can you make a filling-up sound? Glug, glug, glug!
Can you guess what electric cars do instead?
They plug in to charge, like a tablet!
Let's say it together: GAS STATION!
One more time, nice and loud: GAS STATION!
Many gas stations also have air to fill up the tires.
Who's next? Here's a clue: cars go here to get clean and shiny! Can you guess?
A car wash gives cars a bath.
First, soapy bubbles cover the car from top to bottom.
Big soft brushes spin and scrub the dirt away.
Can you scrub like a car wash brush? Scrub, scrub!
Can you guess what comes after the soap?
Water rinses the soap away! Splish, splash!
Let's say it together: CAR WASH!
One more time, nice and loud: CAR WASH!
Then warm air blows the car dry. So shiny!
Who's next? Here's a clue: cars come here to get fixed! Can you guess?
A garage is where mechanics fix cars and trucks.
Mechanics use tools, like wrenches, to fix things.
They check the tires, the lights and the engine.
Can you turn a pretend wrench? Twist, twist!
Can you guess how mechanics look under a car?
A car lift raises the car way up high!
One more time, nice and loud: GARAGE!
Tow trucks like me bring cars to the garage to be fixed.
Who's last? Here's a clue: it takes away bottles, cans and paper! Can you guess?
A recycling truck picks up the recycling bins.
Bottles, cans and paper go into the back.
It drives them all to the recycling center.
Can you sort with me? Paper here, cans there!
Can you guess what happens to the old cans and paper?
They get made into brand-new things!
Let's say it together: RECYCLING TRUCK!
One more time, nice and loud: RECYCLING TRUCK!
Recycling helps keep our planet clean and green.

recap: What a fun trip around town! Let's remember.
Red means stop, and green means go.
Electric cars plug in to charge.
The car wash rinses with water.
The garage has a car lift.
And recycling makes old things new again!
outro: Which stop was your favorite? Be kind, and wave hello to your neighbors.
Bye, friends! See you in Tiny Truck Town!
